consent_text:
TBAM 匿名路线人工评判：收集暂停通知

本轮人工评判已经暂停。研究团队正在核对每种方法是否均使用训练完成后的最佳模型结果；当前目录不得用于正式收集，也请勿继续作答。

新用户注册、草稿保存、提交以及修改判断均已从浏览器本地协议层禁用。此前版本的活动进度不会被读取到当前协议中。若此浏览器中存在此前版本的数据，页面只允许将其导出留档；该数据不得作为正式实验结果提交。

请等待研究负责人发送新的已验证评判链接。GitHub 仍可能为安全目的记录 Pages 访问者的 IP 地址，但本暂停页面不会收集或上传新的评判结果。
consent_text_en:
TBAM Anonymous Route Human Evaluation: Collection Paused

This human-evaluation round is paused while the research team verifies that every method is represented by its best fully trained model. Do not use the current catalog for formal collection and do not continue rating.

New registration, draft saving, submission, and judgment revision are disabled at the browser-local protocol layer. Active progress from the previous version is not read into this protocol. If this browser contains previous-version data, the page only permits exporting it for archival purposes; it must not be submitted as a formal experimental result.

Wait for the study coordinator to provide a new verified evaluation link. GitHub may still record Pages visitors' IP addresses for security purposes, but this paused page does not collect or upload new evaluation responses.
